evidence: Touches startup argument handling and settings validation in src/init.cpp and various option parsers across node initialization.
rationale: Enforces strict bounds and range validation on configuration and command-line arguments to prevent silent integer wrap-around and overflows. Negative or excessively large values previously caused bugs such as disabling database batch flushing during reindex (-dbbatchsize), getting permanently stuck in IBD (-maxtipage), or silently forcing wallet transactions onto fallback fees (-txconfirmtarget).
